notes: Calendar race time is scheduled UTC; a replay origin is only established when a recorded session-start record is available. Final classification is distinct from live position updates.
Lap times, compounds, intervals and positional telemetry are shown only when separately available. Results are never converted into invented car trajectories.

Lap start/duration/sectors, position updates, stints, pits and race control are recorded OpenF1 data. Pit entry time is inferred as message timestamp minus recorded pit-lane duration, not an exact crossing time. Stationary service duration remains null when the provider did not supply it.

Lap start/duration/sectors, position updates, stints, pits and race control are recorded OpenF1 data. Pit entry time is inferred as message timestamp minus recorded pit-lane duration, not an exact crossing time. Stationary service duration remains null when the provider did not supply it.

Full-session recorded location values are sampled near each whole replay second. Each tuple retains its original provider timestamp and values. No trajectory is generated from lap times. The browser interpolates only valid adjacent location samples separated by at most three seconds.
Car telemetry channels are not bundled for this race; speed, throttle, brake, RPM, gear and DRS must display unavailable.

Cars are hidden before a valid first coordinate and across unsupported gaps; DNS and retired entries do not receive invented movement. Finished cars hold a valid final recorded coordinate. Model geometry and cockpit views are original illustrative reconstructions, not scans or onboard footage.
Track visual reference comes from PIA lap 50; the actual car coordinates are never snapped to this path. Provider coordinates do not establish exact track elevation or lateral car placement.
Recorded race start 2025-04-20T17:03:55.449Z. Each driver's replay coverage ends at its final completed competitive lap. Official classification totals remain separately available.

Position displays retain the latest actual provider position update, including the pre-start grid update when a driver never changes position. This is a recorded last-known position, not a newly inferred overtake.
